title: Promontory Route Railroad Trestles, Trestle 790A, 11 miles west of Corrine, Corinne, Box Elder County, UT
notes: Significance: This trestle is one of many remaining Promontory Route railroad trestles which were originally part of the first transcontinental railroad route across the United States.  These trestles represent a class of small utilitarian wooden trestles constructed throughout the country during the latter half of the 19th century.
